description: This file defines the BitConfigField class, a UI component for configuring individual bits within a byte, integrating with a messaging system to update its state based on messages and allowing user interaction to change the bit's value.

classes.name: BitConfigField
classes.description: A UI component representing a configurable bit within a byte, with listening capabilities for external messages and user interaction handling.

methods.name: BitConfigField
methods.description: Constructor initializing UI components, registering message listener, and setting up user interaction logic.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the checkbox state to represent the given boolean value and updates internal state.

methods.name: loadValue
methods.description: Loads the current value of the bit from the given ConfigurationImage object.
